package.name: san_external_mocks
package.description:
SkyHunter v1.5.3 — DCN-2026-021 mock services for external vendors (Tier 3 per ADR-008 — test/tool, C++ for CI integration).
Currently hosts: * rosbridge_mock_server — synthetic publishers for the topics Aban Co. Android App subscribes to. Lets the Aban dev team build/iterate UI without robot hardware, against the schema published in docs/external/Aban_Android_rosbridge_schema_v2.md.
NOTE on topic backends (v1.5.3 phase B): The mock publishes ALL topics listed in the v2 schema, including those whose production backends are not yet implemented (gate_demo_orchestrator → DCN-2026-016, MC retransmit → DCN-2026-019). Aban can develop UI against the full schema; production receive will activate as each backend lands.
Refs: * DCN-2026-021 — this DCN * [[ADR-008]] — Tier 3 test/tool, C++ acceptable * docs/external/Aban_Android_rosbridge_schema_v2.md — the spec this mock implements
